title: Model Profile v1
description: Model Profile registers real hardware/backend capability differences plus device-flow behavior facts. v1 is atomic with firmware; only profileVersion 1 is supported.

profileVersion.description: Locked to 1 for v1. Bump only when fields change type/semantics or are removed.

expectedBackends.description: Backend engineering identifiers supported by this model. Dev/CI/diagnostic-only; does not participate in feature selection or block UI.

capabilities.description: Frontend product capability baseline for this model. Keys are exactly CAPABILITY_KEYS; no *Api/platform/backend engineering names. Schedule/WPS/WAN Ping/Device Limit/LED are common functions and must NOT appear here.

behavior.description: Device flow facts only. Must NOT expose upgrading, Promise finally, error-page jumping, etc.

meshRadioStatus.description: Radio status/control exposed by the shared Mesh topology: M6-style 2.4 GHz band control or read-only transmit power.
